stem: The fi rst Political Organization established in India in 1838 was known as
expl: The fi rst political organization established in India was known as the Zamindari Association or Landholders Society (1838 A.D.) in Calcutta. It was the fi rst political organisation which introduced organized efforts and constitutional remedies for complaints. Its main purpose was to secure the interests of landlords. The founder members were Dwaraka Nath Tagore and his associate landlords.
